mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility bottomed at -38.9 in t-1w and rebounded to -31.6 in t-0w, marking the resumption of non-work trip-making. This transit recovery persists and mechanically carries shoppers back to retail corridors, so mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than the last 28 days.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose from -38.9 at t-1w to -31.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is at or below the last-28-day mean whenever TRANSIT rebounds by 5 or more points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM crossing zero (from -6.1 at t-1w to 0.0 at t-0w) marks the end of emergency pantry-loading. Once households stop diverting spend to staples, discretionary in-person shopping resumes, lifting RETAIL_REC within one week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM crosses to >= 0.0 percent change from baseline
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM moved from -6.1 at t-1w to 0.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: In weeks where GROCERY_PHARM is at or above 0.0, RETAIL_REC fails to exceed its prior-week value in at least half of observed cases.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL stays elevated (9.4 to 13.0 in every week) while WORKPLACES remains 20-plus points below baseline. The combination locks in home-centric routines: even as some work trips resume, discretionary retail trips stay suppressed, so RETAIL_REC declines over two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL ranged 9.4 to 13.0 across all four weeks
failure_condition: When RESIDENTIAL >= 9.4 and WORKPLACES < -20 jointly hold, RETAIL_REC rises over the following 14 days in more than half of observations.

mechanism_narrative: The 14.4-point WORKPLACES collapse at t-1w (-22.9 to -37.3) shows how fast restrictions can be re-imposed. A repeat of that magnitude signals tightening containment that closes retail capacity, driving RETAIL_REC lower over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls more than 10 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell from -22.9 at t-2w to -37.3 at t-1w
failure_condition: Following any week-on-week WORKPLACES drop greater than 10 points, mean RETAIL_REC rises rather than falls over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS fell from -10.4 at t-3w to -20.9 at t-0w as cold weather pushed leisure indoors. That displaced outdoor time converts into indoor commercial activity, so retail-and-recreation visits rise over the next two weeks of the winter holiday period.
candidate_trigger: PARKS below -15 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell 10.5 points from t-3w to t-0w
regime_hint: winter holiday season with cold-weather park avoidance
failure_condition: In weeks where PARKS is below -15 for two straight weeks, RETAIL_REC declines over the following 14 days instead of rising.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS below -15 and TRANSIT below -30 at the same time indicate a broad withdrawal from out-of-home activity that is not offset by residential substitution. The joint weakness drags retail footfall down over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS below -15 and TRANSIT below -30 simultaneously
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT has held below -30 in all four weeks
regime_hint: winter resurgence with suppressed out-of-home activity
failure_condition: When PARKS < -15 and TRANSIT < -30 jointly hold, RETAIL_REC over the following 14 days exceeds its prior 14-day level in the majority of cases.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL has averaged 10.6 points above baseline over the four weeks and never dropped below 9.4, showing home time is structurally elevated. This caps the number of discretionary retail trips, so RETAIL_REC stays below its trailing mean one week ahead.
failure_condition: On weeks where RESIDENTIAL >= 9.4, the following 7-day RETAIL_REC mean is at or above the preceding 7-day mean in more than half of observations.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC improved from -31.6 at t-3w to -27.9 at t-0w at the same time GROCERY_PHARM reached parity. Momentum in the retail series plus the end of staple stockpiling compound into continued gains over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC holds above -30 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 3.7 points from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: When RETAIL_REC stays above -30 for two consecutive weeks, its next-28-day mean is lower than its last-28-day mean in over half of instances.
